title: Cary, NC — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Cary, NC: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Cary is a city in NC with a population of 175,000. One of America’s safest cities with top schools, tech jobs, and Research Triangle access. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
